name: SAP S/4HANA End-to-End
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Financial Accounting
SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Sales

beginner.summary: For participants new to SAP. Covers navigation, enterprise structure, master data and the core business processes (procure to pay, order to cash, finance, controlling and production) in SAP S/4HANA, ending with an end-to-end scenario.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of how companies buy, make and sell
Access to an SAP S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Run the core end-to-end business processes
Answer business questions with standard reports

subtopics: What SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA do
On-premise, private cloud and public cloud editions
SAP GUI and SAP Fiori launchpad
Clients, development, quality and production systems
Users and roles at a glance
days.lab_task: Sign in to the training system through SAP GUI and the Fiori launchpad, find five given business documents, save three transactions as favourites, and personalise one Fiori app.
days.deliverable: Navigation log with document numbers, favourites and a personalised app
checks: Order displayed with its customer and items
Open the same function in SAP GUI and in Fiori
Explain why changes are not made directly in production
Development, quality and production roles described
objectives: Navigate SAP S/4HANA in SAP GUI and Fiori

outcomes.outcome: Navigate both SAP GUI and SAP Fiori launchpad to locate standard sales, purchasing, and financial documents
outcomes.assessed_by: Lab checks: document list and verification log

outcomes.outcome: Customise user shortcuts by adding standard transaction codes to SAP GUI favourites and personalising launchpad app tiles
outcomes.assessed_by: Lab check: favourites list and launchpad personalisation layout

outcomes.outcome: Explain the difference between development, quality assurance, and production clients in an SAP S/4HANA landscape
Diagnose and resolve user permission issues and missing parameter defaults during transaction navigation

subtopics: Evolution from SAP R/3 to S/4HANA
topics.failure_scenario: A transaction report fails to run because the user selected an legacy ERP transaction code deprecated in S/4HANA.
topics.best_practice: Use modern S/4HANA transaction codes or Fiori apps rather than legacy R/3 transactions.

subtopics: System landscapes: Dev, QA, and Prod
topics.failure_scenario: Configuration changes made directly in a QA environment are overwritten during the next transport import.
topics.best_practice: Perform all configuration changes in the Development environment and transport them through QA to Production.

topics.topic: SAP GUI Navigation and Transaction Codes
subtopics: Standard status bar and system information
Setting user parameters with transaction SU3
topics.failure_scenario: A user repeatedly enters full document numbers manually because default parameters are not set in user profile settings.
topics.best_practice: Set standard user parameter IDs in transaction SU3 to populate default company codes and plants automatically.

topics.topic: SAP Fiori Launchpad and User Interface
subtopics: Searching for apps and business objects
Comparing SAP GUI and Fiori interfaces
topics.failure_scenario: A user cannot locate a required tile because the space filter is restricting the visible app groups on the launchpad.
topics.best_practice: Use global search in Fiori launchpad when tiles are missing from personalized page layouts.

topics.topic: Demo: SAP GUI Favourites and Document Search
subtopics: Searching for sales orders with wildcards
topics.failure_scenario: Document search returns no results because search wildcards were omitted in numeric search fields.
topics.best_practice: Use wildcards such as asterisk when searching for partial document descriptions or customer names.

topics.topic: Demo: SAP Fiori App Personalisation and Tiles
subtopics: Adding tiles from the App Finder
topics.failure_scenario: An app tile disappears from the launchpad home page after a user inadvertently clears local layout preferences.
topics.best_practice: Save custom tile configurations as named views to easily restore group layouts.

topics.topic: Lab: Sign in to the training system through SAP GUI and the Fiori launchpad, find five given business documents, save three transactions as favourites, and personalise one Fiori app
subtopics: Log into SAP GUI and Fiori launchpad
Search and display five target business documents
Add three standard transaction codes to GUI favourites
Personalise Fiori launchpad page layout with a new tile
Document findings and numbers in the navigation log
topics.best_practice: Verify document numbers across both SAP GUI and Fiori interfaces to ensure consistency.

subtopics: Inspect user authorizations and profile parameters
Identify missing security role or parameter assignment
Grant required privilege and re-test transaction access
topics.failure_scenario: A user receives an authorization error when executing transaction VA03 due to missing role assignments in their profile.
topics.best_practice: Check user authorization logs in transaction SU53 immediately after receiving access error messages.

seeded_failure.symptom: When entering transaction code VA03 in SAP GUI, the system displays an authorization check error message and blocks access.
seeded_failure.cause: The participant's user account is missing the display authorization role Z_S4_SALES_DISPLAY containing transaction VA03.
seeded_failure.fix: Assign role Z_S4_SALES_DISPLAY to the user profile via transaction SU01 or log in with the designated display training account.

Which transaction code allows a user to maintain their own default parameters and defaults?
What syntax character acts as a wildcard when searching for business documents in SAP GUI?
How do custom transaction code shortcuts in SAP GUI differ from Fiori launchpad tiles?
What system environment in a standard landscape is used for final user acceptance testing?
Which authorization transaction displays missing access privileges immediately after a failure?

Successfully logs into both interfaces after standard setup steps
Logs into SAP GUI or Fiori launchpad, but fails to access one interface
Unable to log into either SAP interface
Document Identification
Finds all five documents in both GUI and Fiori, recording complete header and item details
Finds all five assigned business documents and records document numbers
Finds three or four business documents
Finds fewer than three business documents
UI Personalisation
Saves three GUI favourites and customises a Fiori app group with saved custom filters
Saves three GUI favourites and adds one personalised Fiori tile
Saves GUI favourites or customises Fiori tile, but not both
Fails to create GUI favourites or personalise Fiori app
Troubleshooting the seeded failure
Identifies missing authorization role via SU53 and resolves access without trainer assistance
Identifies missing authorization error and resolves access with a single hint
Identifies the error message but cannot determine the missing privilege
Does not attempt to diagnose the authorization failure

subtopics: Sales organisation, distribution channel and division

days.deliverable: Enterprise structure diagram and annotated documents
checks: Company code, plants, sales and purchasing organisations linked correctly
Sales organisation, channel and division identified
objectives: Read the enterprise structure from the system
Link organisational units to business documents

outcomes.outcome: Identify core organisational units including company code, plant, storage location, sales organisation, and purchasing organisation
Trace enterprise structure relationships across financial, purchasing, and sales modules in system configuration tables
outcomes.assessed_by: Lab check: enterprise structure diagram and cross-module mapping table

outcomes.outcome: Extract and verify organisational unit header data from active sales orders and purchase orders
outcomes.assessed_by: Lab checks: annotated sales order and purchase order document displays

outcomes.outcome: Diagnose configuration gaps where missing assignments between organisational units prevent document creation

subtopics: Company code purpose and legal reporting
Linkages between Controlling and Financial Accounting
topics.failure_scenario: General ledger postings fail because the company code is not assigned to a valid controlling area.
topics.best_practice: Assign company codes to a controlling area with identical fiscal year variants and charts of accounts.

topics.failure_scenario: Inventory goods receipts fail because the physical storage location is not assigned to the receiving plant.
topics.best_practice: Define distinct storage locations under a plant to separate raw materials, work in process, and finished goods.

subtopics: Sales organisation, distribution channel, and division
topics.failure_scenario: Sales order creation fails because the sales organisation and distribution channel combination is not defined as a valid sales area.
topics.best_practice: Ensure every sales organisation, distribution channel, and division combination is explicitly assigned in customising.

subtopics: Impact of org units on postings
topics.failure_scenario: A purchase order cannot be saved because the purchasing organisation is not linked to the target plant.
topics.best_practice: Verify cross-module assignments in SPRO whenever new logistics or financial org units are created.

topics.topic: Demo: Displaying Enterprise Structure in SPRO
topics.failure_scenario: A configuration display view shows incomplete structures because display depth filters are active.
topics.best_practice: Use standard hierarchy display tools in SPRO to view all linked parent and child organizational units.

topics.topic: Demo: Tracing Organisational Units on Business Documents
subtopics: Identifying sales area on order header
Opening purchase order header and line items
Linking plant and storage location on line items
topics.failure_scenario: A line item determination error occurs because the item's plant does not belong to the order's company code.
topics.best_practice: Check header organizational data first before diagnosing line item plant or storage location assignment issues.

topics.topic: Lab: Draw the enterprise structure of the training company from the system, then show which organisational units appear on one sales order and one purchase order
subtopics: Examine customising definitions in transaction SPRO
Diagram company code, plant, sales, and purchasing units
Display a standard sales order and record organizational headers
Display a standard purchase order and record organizational headers
Annotate relationships between document fields and enterprise structure
topics.best_practice: Cross-check document organisational units against system configuration assignments to confirm validity.

subtopics: Analyze system error messages in SPRO
topics.failure_scenario: Creating a purchase order fails with an error stating that plant 1000 is not assigned to purchasing organisation 1000.
topics.best_practice: Trace error messages directly to the assignment folder in SPRO enterprise structure customising.

seeded_failure.symptom: When attempting to create a purchase order for plant 1000, the system rejects the transaction stating plant 1000 is not assigned to purchasing organisation 1000.
seeded_failure.cause: The trainer removed the assignment between purchasing organisation 1000 and plant 1000 in transaction SPRO customising settings.
seeded_failure.fix: Navigate to SPRO > Enterprise Structure > Assignment > Materials Management > Assign purchasing organization to plant, re-add the assignment, and save.

lab_rubric: Enterprise Structure Diagramming
Draws a complete, error-free structural diagram showing all financial, logistics, sales, and purchasing units with cross-module linkages
Draws an accurate structural diagram linking company code, plants, sales, and purchasing organisations
Diagrams major units but omits cross-module links or storage locations
Diagram is incomplete or contains incorrect structural assignments
Sales Order Org Unit Mapping
Accurately identifies all header sales area units and item plant assignments, explaining their accounting impact
Accurately identifies sales organisation, distribution channel, division, and plant from sales order header and items
Identifies some sales org units but misses distribution channel or division
Fails to identify sales organizational units from the document
Purchase Order Org Unit Mapping
Accurately maps purchasing org, group, plant, and storage location and explains their enterprise assignments
Accurately identifies purchasing organisation, purchasing group, plant, and storage location on purchase order
Identifies purchasing org but misses plant or storage location details
Fails to identify purchasing organizational units from the document
Troubleshooting the seeded failure
Locates missing plant assignment in SPRO immediately and restores configuration without assistance
Locates missing plant assignment in SPRO and restores configuration with a minimal hint
Identifies that an assignment is missing in customising but cannot locate the exact SPRO node
Fails to diagnose or fix the enterprise structure error
